spotlight.name: Our House of Hope Rescue
spotlight.description: Our House of Hope Rescue is a wonderful organization that goes beyond simple animal rescue. They strive to build a caring and connected community where people and pets bring out the best in each other. Through their various outreach programs and partnerships, they create hope, healing, and connection for all.
keyImpacts: Bringing seniors together for conversation and animal socialization through their Coffee & Cuddles program.
Supporting domestic violence survivors by providing resources and temporary support for their pets through Bridge of Hope.
Reducing rescue intakes by supplying dog and cat food to low-income families via their Pet Food Pantry.
Offering a safe and peaceful environment for families to train and bond with their dogs at the Center for Enrichment.
Empowering the community through education on responsible pet ownership and animal welfare.
Providing dedicated care and loving retirement homes for beagles retiring from research facilities.

monthlyFacts.fact: Globally, at least 2 billion people use a drinking water source contaminated with feces.
The ocean produces more than 50 percent of the oxygen on Earth.
Less than 1% of the water on Earth is fresh and accessible.
Over 80% of wastewater is discharged without any pollution removal.
Agriculture is the largest consumer of water, accounting for 70% of total global freshwater withdrawals.
The deep sea is the largest habitat on Earth, yet less than 5% of it has been explored by humans.
By 2025, half of the world’s population will be living in water-stressed areas.
Up to 12.7 million metric tons of plastic waste enters the ocean each year.
Groundwater provides almost half of all drinking water worldwide.
Ocean acidification, caused by the uptake of CO2, is threatening marine ecosystems.
Just 10 rivers are responsible for transporting more than 90% of the plastic waste that ends up in the oceans.

_messagesHelp: === HOW TO USE 'messages' (this key is ignored by the app) ===
Each message is an object in the 'messages' array. Required: id, title, body. Everything else is optional.
id: unique string. Changing the id makes the message 'new' again (re-shows the unread badge).
title / body: text shown to the user.
link / linkText: optional button. link = URL to open, linkText = button label.
minBuildNumber: show only on builds >= this number (inclusive). Omit = no lower limit.
maxBuildNumber: show only on builds <= this number (inclusive). Omit = no upper limit.
expiresAfter: date 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Hidden after this date. Invalid date = message never shows.
platform: 'ios' or 'android' (not case-sensitive). Omit = all platforms. Any other value = never shown.
!! platform only works on build 50 and newer. Builds 49 and older IGNORE it and show the message on BOTH platforms.
!! To reach older builds, use neutral wording + maxBuildNumber: 49 instead of platform.
All conditions must pass for a message to show. Messages never show if the app can't read its own build number.
Build numbers: odd = Android, even = iOS (since build 45). Builds 44 and earlier went to both platforms.
TestFlight vs App Store users on the same build number cannot be told apart.

Example (TestFlight migration, all old builds): {"id":"v101-available","title":"Version 1.0.1 is here!","body":"...","link":"https://apps.apple.com/app/id6763444372","linkText":"Open App Store","maxBuildNumber":49,"expiresAfter":"2027-01-31"}

messages.title: Thank You, Founding Testers! 💧
messages.body:
Get Water Strong 1.0.1 is now live on the App Store(s)! Thank you for testing early versions and for all your feedback. You helped shape this app and we're truly greatful. To move to the official version:
1. Back up data (just incase): GWS Settings → Data Management → Backup Data.
2. Install Get Water Strong from the official App Store. It replaces the pre-release version.
3. Please leave a review in the app store.

Questions? Email photos@GetWaterStrong.com.
